targetTexts.1: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
targetTexts.2: for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
targetTexts.3: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
targetTexts.4: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
targetTexts.5: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
targetTexts.6: in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
targetTexts.7: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
targetTexts.8: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
targetTexts.9: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your crops;
targetTexts.10: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
targetTexts.11: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke;
targetTexts.12: for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights.
targetTexts.13: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding,
targetTexts.14: for she is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than fine gold.
targetTexts.15: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire compares with her.
targetTexts.16: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
targetTexts.17: All her ways are pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful.
targetTexts.18: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her, and those who lay hold of her are blessed.
targetTexts.19: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.
targetTexts.20: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.
targetTexts.21: My son, do not lose sight of this: Preserve sound judgment and discernment.
targetTexts.22: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck.
targetTexts.23: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
targetTexts.24: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
targetTexts.25: Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
targetTexts.26: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare.
targetTexts.27: Do not withhold good from the deserving when it is within your power to act.
targetTexts.28: Do not tell your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I will provide”—when you already have the means.
targetTexts.29: Do not devise evil against your neighbor, for he trustfully dwells beside you.
targetTexts.30: Do not accuse a man without cause, when he has done you no harm.
targetTexts.31: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways;
targetTexts.32: for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.
targetTexts.33: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but He blesses the home of the righteous.
targetTexts.34: He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
targetTexts.35: The wise will inherit honor, but fools are held up to shame.
